title: Light — one Math Engine, five source types, aim and beam footprint
description:
A parametric LIGHT on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A NODE where the fitting goes. Rotation aims it in plan; `aimTilt` aims it in section.

IT DOES NOT LIGHT ANYTHING. No photometry, no IES, no falloff, no shadows. It is the fitting, the aim and the schedule numbers — the part that belongs in a drawing and in a coordination model, and that survives being handed to any renderer. Use `downlight-with-math` when you want a recessed spot with a real trim and cutout; this is the generic source marker for a render setup.

AIM IS MEASURED FROM STRAIGHT DOWN, because that is how a ceiling fitting is specified: 0° is a downlight, 90° is a wall washer lying on its side. Every later expression reads `_aimR` and none of them knows which type it is.

THE FIVE TYPES SHARE ONE BODY. Area and Linear are the same box with different numbers in it; Point, Spot and Directional emit nothing to draw, because for those the beam IS the shape. So the type changes what is drawn without changing what anything is.

THE FOOTPRINT IS THE CIRCLE THAT INSCRIBES THE ELLIPSE. A tilted beam lands as an ellipse; this draws the circle at the point where the axis meets the floor, with the radius the slant distance gives. That is what a lighting plan wants and it is honestly an approximation — `axisFloorOffset` reports how far the aim has walked the beam across the floor.

EFFICACY AND AVERAGE LUX ARE ARITHMETIC ON THE INPUTS, not a simulation: lumens over watts, and lumens over the footprint area. They are sanity figures for a schedule, and they say so.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS: a 9 W, 800 lm, 3000 K spot at 2.7 m aiming straight down — 88.9 lm/W, a 1.755 m footprint, about 331 lx average.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. No IES distribution, no inverse-square falloff, no colour mixing, no shadows. The footprint is a circle, not a true ellipse. A linear source is a straight bar; a curved cove is several of these.

props.name: Semantics
props.value: architectural light source marker, warm, for a render setup

params.name: Light maths
params.expr:
_natL = housing
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_isPoint = type == 'Point'
_isSpot = type == 'Spot'
_isArea = type == 'Area'
_isLinear = type == 'Linear'
_isDir = type == 'Directional'
_mz = mountHeight * _s
_hs = housing * _s
_sL = sizeLength * _s
_sW = sizeWidth * _s
_rch = reach * _s
_bodyL = max(_hs, _isArea ? _sL : (_isLinear ? _sL : _hs))
_bodyW = max(_hs, _isArea ? _sW : _hs)
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
_wcx = _cu * _ux + _cv * _vx
_wcy = _cu * _uy + _cv * _vy
# Aim is measured from straight DOWN, because that is how a ceiling fitting is specified: 0° is a
# downlight, 90° is a wall washer lying on its side.
_aimR = aimTilt * PI / 180
_aimU = _rch * sin(_aimR)
_aimZ = _mz - _rch * cos(_aimR)
# Housing — every type has one, so the object reads as a fitting and not as a floating symbol.
_HOUS = hcat(0 - _hs / 2, 0 - _hs / 2, _hs / 2, 0 - _hs / 2, _hs / 2, _hs / 2, 0 - _hs / 2, _hs / 2, _mz, _mz + _hs * 0.6, 1)
# The emitter. Area is a panel, Linear is a bar; both are one box with different numbers in it,
# and the other three types emit nothing to draw here because their shape is the beam.
_emT = 0.02 * _s
_PANEL = hcat(0 - _sL / 2, 0 - _sW / 2, _sL / 2, 0 - _sW / 2, _sL / 2, _sW / 2, 0 - _sL / 2, _sW / 2, _mz - _emT, _mz, 2)
_BAR = hcat(0 - _sL / 2, 0 - _hs / 4, _sL / 2, 0 - _hs / 4, _sL / 2, _hs / 4, 0 - _sL / 2, _hs / 4, _mz - _emT, _mz, 2)
_EMIT = _isArea ? _PANEL : (_isLinear ? _BAR : zeros(0, 11))
Q = vcat(_HOUS, _EMIT)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Housing3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Emitter3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
HousingPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
EmitterPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 2)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Beam footprint where the axis meets the floor. The cone is drawn to that circle rather than
# perpendicular to the axis — a tilted beam lands as an ellipse and this is the circle that
# inscribes it, which is what a lighting plan wants and is honestly an approximation.
_slant = _mz / max(0.08, cos(_aimR))
_halfCone = beamAngle * PI / 360
_footR = _slant * tan(_halfCone)
_footU = _mz * tan(_aimR)
_aR = aimRadius * _s
_ck = arange(4)
_ca = _ck * PI / 2
_CONEr = hcat(fill(4,1,0), fill(4,1,0), fill(4,1,_mz), _footU + _footR * cos(_ca), _footR * sin(_ca), fill(4,1,0), fill(4,1,_aR))
_CONE = (showAim > 0 && (_isSpot || _isPoint)) ? _CONEr : zeros(0, 7)
# Directional gets an arrow instead of a cone: a shaft along the aim plus two barbs.
_dirU = _aimU
_dirZ = _aimZ
_bk = arange(2)
_bs = 1 - 2 * _bk
_SHAFT = hcat(0, 0, _mz, _dirU, 0, _dirZ, _aR * 1.5)
_BARB = hcat(fill(2,1,_dirU), fill(2,1,0), fill(2,1,_dirZ), _dirU - _rch * 0.18 * sin(_aimR) + _bs * _rch * 0.10 * cos(_aimR), _bs * 0, _dirZ + _rch * 0.18 * cos(_aimR) + _bs * _rch * 0.10 * sin(_aimR), fill(2,1,_aR * 1.5))
_ARROW = (showAim > 0 && _isDir) ? vcat(_SHAFT, _BARB) : zeros(0, 7)
# A point source shows as a small globe; a linear one shows its own bar and needs no aim.
_GLOBE = _isPoint ? hcat(0, 0, _mz - _hs * 0.35, 0, 0, _mz - _hs * 0.1, _hs * 0.35) : zeros(0, 7)
_AIMLINE = (showAim > 0 && (_isSpot || _isArea || _isLinear)) ? hcat(0, 0, _mz, _aimU, 0, _aimZ, _aR) : zeros(0, 7)
_BEAM = vcat(_CONE, _ARROW, _AIMLINE)
_t1u = _cu + col(_BEAM,0)
_t1v = _cv + col(_BEAM,1)
_t2u = _cu + col(_BEAM,3)
_t2v = _cv + col(_BEAM,4)
Beam3D = hcat(_t1u * _ux + _t1v * _vx, _t1u * _uy + _t1v * _vy, col(_BEAM,2), _t2u * _ux + _t2v * _vx, _t2u * _uy + _t2v * _vy, col(_BEAM,5), col(_BEAM,6))
_t1u = _cu + col(_GLOBE,0)
_t1v = _cv + col(_GLOBE,1)
_t2u = _cu + col(_GLOBE,3)
_t2v = _cv + col(_GLOBE,4)
Globe3D = hcat(_t1u * _ux + _t1v * _vx, _t1u * _uy + _t1v * _vy, col(_GLOBE,2), _t2u * _ux + _t2v * _vx, _t2u * _uy + _t2v * _vy, col(_GLOBE,5), col(_GLOBE,6))
# Plan symbols
_fpx = (_cu + _footU) * _ux + _cv * _vx
_fpy = (_cu + _footU) * _uy + _cv * _vy
FootprintPlan = (showAim > 0 && (_isSpot || _isPoint)) ? hcat(_fpx, _fpy, _footR) : zeros(0, 3)
SourcePlan = hcat(_wcx, _wcy, max(_hs / 2, 0.03 * _s))
# Metrics — the numbers a lighting schedule asks for, all arithmetic on the inputs.
sourceWatts = power
sourceLumens = lumens
efficacy = power > 0 ? (lumens / power) : 0
colourTemp = kelvin
colourRendering = cri
beamAngleOut = beamAngle
footprintDiameter = (_isSpot || _isPoint) ? (2 * _footR) : 0
footprintArea = (_isSpot || _isPoint) ? (PI * _footR * _footR) : 0
averageLux = ((_isSpot || _isPoint) && _footR > 0.01) ? (lumens / (PI * _footR * _footR)) : 0
emitterArea = _isArea ? (_sL * _sW) : (_isLinear ? (_sL * _hs / 2) : 0)
mountElevation = _mz
aimFromDown = aimTilt
throwDistance = _rch
axisFloorOffset = _footU
